items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Well in 26 I was playing with Chris Keller.

ctx.x: But a valve had to come true. Yeah, that's the exact note on that.

Yeah, that's right. Yeah, that's was wonderful times then. When I first came down here we used to, when I did start to go in Goodwill, things were pretty good. That's in the 20s, early 20s. Well in 26 I was playing with Chris Keller.
Well can you tell us a little bit, before you get there about your lessons with Dave Perkins, what he taught you, what kind of a book you used or anything else you can remember about your lessons?
